sentence: When GET /api/stats/harvests returns a malformed or non-JSON 200 response (e.g. '{}' or an HTML body), /stats throws a render error or shows a garbage table instead of an error state.
evidence: Signed in as demo user, loaded Dashboard, then used Playwright page.route to fulfil GET /api/stats/harvests with 200 (a) application/json '{}' and (b) text/html '<html>proxy</html>', and clicked the 'Stats' nav link. In both cases the URL changed to /stats but the Dashboard content stayed on screen (title 'Dashboard · Garden Log'), a Nuxt error dialog appeared with h1 "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')", the console logged '[Vue warn]: Unhandled error during execution of render function at <Stats>', and a pageerror 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')' was thrown. No AlertMessage or retry was shown. Cause: stats.vue's template checks `stats && stats.plants.length` with no validation of the response shape (useApiFetch treats any 200 as data), and formatMonth calls value.slice without a null guard.
